title: Compare generated vs reference
objective: Run ref_hex8_plastic.py::solve_plastic() and generated J2 solver on same 1-element problem. Assert displacement field max difference < 1e-10.
implementation_steps: Add test to test_e2e_plastic.py (or separate function in same file)
Run generated J2 solver on same problem using E2E infrastructure
If FD tangent prevents meeting 1e-10: document and use relaxed tolerance with justification
deliverables: Test comparing generated vs reference solver
acceptance_criteria: Same problem setup for both solvers
risks: Risk: FD tangent precision floor may prevent meeting 1e-10 for plastic. Mitigation: document and use relaxed tolerance (1e-8) with justification if needed.
completion_notes: Max displacement diff: 1.188e-16 (machine epsilon) — strict 1e-10 spec easily met
No tolerance relaxation needed: displacement-controlled loading converges to identical equilibrium regardless of tangent approximation
5 load steps, displacement 0.01, same material and BC setup for both solvers
